fix.q: Sukhna Lake, which was added to India's list of Ramsar sites in October 2026, is located in:
fix.explanation: Sukhna Wetland, a reservoir created in 1958 at the foot of the Shivalik hills, is Chandigarh's first Ramsar site. It was announced on 15 October 2026 together with Sauj Jheel in Mainpuri district, Uttar Pradesh, taking India's total to 103. Mainpuri is now the only district with two Ramsar sites (the other is Saman Bird Sanctuary). Source: News On AIR, 16 Oct 2026.
